The figure draws experiment 27 ("Unseen-ground confidence calibration unlocks the reinstated 3×-capacity trunk") in the shared visual language, reusing the exact stage geometry of the neighboring exp 26 figure so the two read side-by-side down the gallery page: camera frame (frozen glyph at x=26) → rotation fan → four-slab MobileNetV3 encoder with kernel-projection ties → 608-d layout-summary bar → lighting gate (σ) → FC fans into the 32×32 probability map → converge-line decode to the crosshair at x=812 → frozen `(lat, lon, confidence)` output at x=828.

Red is placed on exactly what this experiment changed, per `architecture.stages[].changed`:
- the fourth encoder slab and its 8²×96 label (the reinstated 3× trunk), with a top margin note "3× trunk + int8 heads — reinstated / exp 26's gain was real; only the bar was wrong",
- the FC scorer fans ("int8 FC heads — reinstated"),
- the confidence gauge, relabeled "Confidence — recalibrated · bar tuned on fenced-off, never-trained blocks",
- a new training-lane glyph directly beneath the gauge: an 8×8 map grid with ~1-in-10 cells filled red ("Calibration blocks — new"), tied to the gauge by a red dashed leader, plus a red note that fresh draws now skip those blocks and the 182-px no-peek ring.

Unchanged training signals (Gaussian-CE target, committed-coord L2, confidence BCE, 24 cosine passes) stay in ochre with an orthogonal dashed leader from the probability map. ViewBox is 980×440 to give the training lane room for the calibration-map glyph without crowding.
